examples.title: GridColColumnOption
examples.description: Describes the numbers of grid columns occupied by the GridCol component on devices with different width types.
examples.code:
span: {xs:2, md:4, lg:8} // Equivalent to span: {xs:2, sm:2, md:4, lg:8, xl:8, xxl:8}.
span: {md:4, lg:8} // Equivalent to span: {xs:1, sm:1, md:4, lg:8, xl:8, xxl:8}.
